name: Wuzhi-10 Helicopter
description: The Changhe Z-10, also known as the WZ-10, is a Chinese medium‑weight attack helicopter developed by the Changhe Aircraft Industries Corporation for the People’s Liberation Army. Designed primarily for anti‑armor warfare with secondary air‑to‑air capability, it first flew in 2003 and entered service in 2009. The helicopter features a tandem cockpit, stub wings for weapons, and advanced systems for close air support and battlefield interdiction.
